# DEGREE 5, DIAMETER 7: 6,000 VERTICES
# ------------------------------------
# 6,000 vertices, 15,000 undirected edges, every vertex of degree 5, every pair of vertices within
# 7 steps of each other.
#
# A regular voltage lift over the group G described below, of order 3,000. The base graph has
# vertices 0 and 1, with three parallel links 0 -> 1 (voltages 1, v(0,1) c z y^4, v(1,4) c z^4
# y^7), a loop at 0 (voltage y) and a loop at 1 (voltage v(0,2) c z^4 y^4).
#
# The lift has vertex set {0, 1} x G and joins (u, g) to (v, g a) for every dart u -> v with
# voltage a; a loop with voltage a joins (v, g) to (v, g a) and (v, g a^-1). G acts on each fibre
# {v} x G by left multiplication.
#
# The group is G = ((F_25 x| <c>) x <z>) x| <y> of order 3000: F_25 = F_5^2 as column vectors, c
# of order 3 acting on F_25 by B = [[0,4],[1,4]] (so F_25 x| <c> is a Frobenius group of order
# 75), z central of order 5 in K = (F_25 x| <c>) x <z>, and y of order 8 acting on K by (w, c^i,
# z^j) -> (A w, c^(2i), z^(2j)) with A = [[1,1],[2,4]]. G is not metacyclic; it has trivial centre
# and 25 involutions. The word v(a,b) c^i z^j y^m stands for the element ((a,b), c^i, z^j) y^m.
#
# Vertex 3000 v + index(g) is the pair (v, g), where g = ((a,b), c^i, z^j) y^m has index (((5 a +
# b) 3 + i) 5 + j) 8 + m, so vertex 3000 v is (v, identity).
#
# One edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered 0..5999.

# loop at base vertex 0, voltage y: (0, g) -- (0, g y)
